initial_scene: A red-topped, blue-faced Rubik cube stands on the top wooden shelf; the middle and bottom levels are empty. Both arms extend forward from below the camera, with the open left hand inactive and the right hand poised to reach.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands remain open; the cube remains on the top shelf.
Right arm rises and extends to the cube on the upper shelf, with fingers opening around it.
Right hand closes around the cube and establishes a grip while it remains near the top shelf.
Right hand lifts the cube fully clear of the top shelf and draws it to the right.
Right hand transports the held cube down and inward to the bottom shelf.
Cube is lowered into the bottom shelf area; the hand remains around the cube while adjusting its position.
Right fingers open apart around the cube, leaving it on the bottom shelf. The hand remains beside it when the clip ends.
